nodes.text: Does every graph on $n$ vertices with $>\mathrm{ex}(n;C_4)$ edges contain $\gg n^{1/2}$ many copies of $C_4$?

#60 : [Er90] [Er93,p.335] graph theory | cycles Conjectured by Erdős and Simonovits, who could not even prove that at least $2$ copies of $C_4$ are guaranteed. The behaviour of $\mathrm{ex}(n;C_4)$ is the subject of [765] . He, Ma, and Yang [HeMaYa21] have proved this conjecture when $n=q^2+q+1$ for some even integer $q$.
